definitions.explanation: The untamed, instinctive nature of an animal or person, as opposed to what has been domesticated or civilized. Often describes rough, raw energy in a person's character.

examples.english: Even dogs retain some wild instincts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレー→プレー：29432_puree⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野性|やせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: You can feel a wild energy in the way he plays.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{眠|ねむ}っていた→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧{野性|やせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ました→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧。
examples.english: Living in the mountains, the wildness that had been dormant in me awoke.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野性|やせい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な: wild, rugged (of a person or style)
- {野性|やせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本能|ほんのう}→本能：07623_honnou⟧: wild instinct
- {野性|やせい}{味|み}: a wild, untamed quality
- {野性|やせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返|かえ}る→返る：29164_kaeru⟧: to revert to the wild

WATCH OUT:
⟦{野生|やせい}→野生：14439_yasei⟧ has the same reading but means living or growing in the wild (⟦{野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧, wild animals). {野性|やせい} is the wild nature or instinct itself. A wild animal is ⟦{野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧; a rugged man is ⟦{野性的|やせいてき}→野性的：23403_yaseiteki⟧.
